objective: Make newly trained portable artifact bundles self-checking against accidental corruption and mixed-run files through a deterministic optional SHA-256 manifest, while preserving every existing artifact schema, public API, and legacy bundle path.
completion_conditions: Each checkpoint durably records its pre-maker baseline, passes its fixed required-test allowlist, and receives a read-only checkpoint verifier PASS before the next checkpoint starts.

The fixed versioned manifest deterministically covers exactly model_definition.json, best_model_state_dict.pt, and class_mapping.json with byte sizes and SHA-256 digests, is atomically published last after successful training artifacts, and cannot remain as false current evidence after a failed or partial replacement.

Single-image inference validates a present same-directory canonical manifest before artifact deserialization, reports bounded actionable integrity failures, and preserves the established behavior of legacy bundles without a manifest and explicit noncanonical artifact paths.

A bounded real local-CPU training-to-GUI-inference graduation proves valid-bundle success, changed-artifact rejection, and legacy compatibility while all prior lifecycle, preview, folder inference, export, cancellation, cleanup, rerun, close, and manual-path contracts remain intact.

README and the Phase 15 document match the implementation and state clearly that checksums are not signatures or provenance, with no change to existing artifact/checkpoint/TorchScript schemas, public controller/worker/request/result APIs, dependencies, launcher, packaging/installer, CUDA behavior, or automatic migration.
No change occurs outside the eleven Phase files, no existing assertion is deleted or meaningfully weakened, and no network-dependent or arbitrary-sleep test is introduced.

After all checkpoint verifiers pass, the Phase-wide read-only verifier evaluates the complete manifest-scoped delta and completion conditions; only its PASS permits the full project harness to run exactly once, and any mutation, ambiguous durable state, failure, or incomplete evidence fails closed without automatic Phase restart.
